ManagerPayPage.sousTitre: You are paid a CPM on the views of the videos assigned to the creators you manage.
ManagerPayPage.pasManager: This screen is for managers only: it shows their CPM earnings.
ManagerPayPage.aucunCpm: No CPM has been set for you on this project yet. As soon as a rate is set for a creator, their views and your earnings will show up here.

ManagerPayReport.aucuneVideo: No published video in this period.
ManagerPayReport.explication: Basis: the paid views of published videos (unpaid warm-up posts excluded, views counted over the 30-day pay window), multiplied by the CPM in effect on each video's publication date: a rate change only applies to videos published afterwards. The month is the video's publication month; a recent month keeps growing as long as its videos get views.
ManagerPayReport.confirmCorps: The payment to {manager} is recorded as is: it's what's left to pay for this month right now.
ManagerPayReport.confirmMoisOuvert: This month can still gain views (30-day window): the difference will then show up as “left to pay”.
ManagerPayReport.annulerCorps: The month becomes due again for the cancelled amount. The payment stays in the history, struck through.
ManagerPayReport.explicationVersements: “Mark as paid” records a payment of what's left to pay. If the videos of a month already paid keep getting views, the difference shows up again as “left to pay”.

VideoBonusEditor.cumulativeOn: A video earns the sum of every threshold it has crossed.
VideoBonusEditor.cumulativeOff: A video only earns the bonus of the highest threshold it has crossed.
VideoBonusEditor.pivotSingle: A video at {views} views earns {amount} — with a single threshold, stacking makes no difference.
VideoBonusEditor.footnote: Views counted: those of paid promo posts, all platforms combined, within the video's pay window. The bonus is added on top of the fixed fee and CPM, outside the per-video cap.
